text: The Supreme Court treated the recorded area, khata number, boundaries and absence of plot 160 in khata 97 as establishing the identity of plot 1060 despite the omitted zero. The program does not independently authenticate the original sale documents or cadastral identity.

Given that attributed identity assessment, the numeric discrepancy alone did not defeat the claim to plot 1060. This resolves the selected identification objection, not every title condition or the separately litigated plots 427 and 1128.
